title: A Unified Framework for Inference with General Missingness Patterns and Machine Learning Imputation
abstract: arXiv:2508.15162v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predictions from machine learning (ML) models are increasingly used to impute missing data, but their naive use risks biased inference. Existing methods provide valid inference with ML imputations regardless of prediction quality to enhance efficiency, while they are limited to either simple missing data structures or a missing-completely-at-random assumption. We develop a novel framework for valid statistical inference in Z-estimation problems using ML imputations under a missing-at-random assumption and for general missingness patterns. The method stratifies data by distinct missingness patterns and constructs an estimator by aggregating pattern-specific observed and prediction information. Theoretically, we establish the asymptotic properties and globally optimal aggregation that guarantees efficiency dominance over weighted complete-case analyses (WCCA). translated_title: 一种适用于一般缺失模式与机器学习插补的统一统计推断框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）模型的预测结果越来越多地被用于插补缺失数据，但简单直接地使用这些预测存在导致有偏推断的风险。现有方法能够在不依赖预测质量的前提下利用机器学习插补实现有效推断以提升效率，但它们仅局限于简单的缺失数据结构或完全随机缺失（MCAR）假设。我们开发了一个新颖的框架，在随机缺失（MAR）假设和一般缺失模式下，利用机器学习插补对Z估计问题进行有效的统计推断。该方法按不同的缺失模式对数据进行分层，并通过聚合各模式特定的观测信息与预测信息来构造估计量。在理论方面，我们建立了该方法的渐近性质和全局最优聚合结果，从而保证其相对于加权完整案例分析（WCCA）具有效率优势。在实际应用中，该方法实现简单，可利用机器学习模型…
tldr: 本文提出了一个在随机缺失假设和一般缺失模式下、结合机器学习插补的统一统计推断框架，通过按缺失模式分层并聚合观测与预测信息构造估计量，理论上保证效率优于加权完整案例分析。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified framework for valid statistical inference with machine learning imputation under missing-at-random assumption and general missingness patterns, which stratifies data by missingness patterns, aggregates pattern-specific observed and prediction information for Z-estimation, and theoretically guarantees efficiency dominance over weighted complete-case analyses.
